g: Quiero que sepan
Quiero que introduces a content clause; sepan is present subjunctive after a verb of desire.
e: no me conocen personalmente
personalmente means ‘personally’ and clarifies the kind of acquaintance denied.

g: para que cobren ánimo
para que takes subjunctive cobren and states the intended encouragement.
e: permanezcan unidos por amor
unidos agrees with the implied plural readers; por amor gives the bond or motive.

g: en quien están escondidos
en quien refers to Cristo; están escondidos is a plural state passive-like description.
e: la sabiduría y del conocimiento
The two nouns are joined by y and both depend on del: ‘of wisdom and knowledge’.

g: para que nadie los engañe
para que + subjunctive engañe gives purpose; los is the object, ‘deceive you’.
e: argumentos capciosos
capcioso describes arguments that sound persuasive but are misleading.

g: Aunque estoy físicamente ausente
Aunque introduces concession; estoy is present while físicamente modifies ausente.
e: los acompaño en espíritu
acompañar means ‘accompany’; en espíritu contrasts with physical absence.

g: de la manera que recibieron
de la manera que means ‘in the manner that’; recibieron is a completed past action.
e: vivan ahora en él
vivan is an exhortative subjunctive/command; ahora marks the consequent present life.

g: como se les enseñó
se enseñó is an impersonal passive-like form; les identifies those taught.
e: llenos de gratitud
llenos agrees with the readers and de names what fills them: gratitude.

g: Cuídense de que nadie los cautive
cuídense de que is followed by subjunctive cautive; it warns against a possible result.
e: vana y engañosa filosofía
Two feminine adjectives agree with filosofía: ‘empty and deceptive philosophy’.

g: habita en forma corporal
habita is singular for plenitud; en forma corporal describes the mode of dwelling.
e: Toda la plenitud
Toda agrees with feminine plenitud and gives it a comprehensive sense.

g: ustedes han recibido
han recibido is present perfect, with ustedes explicitly stated as the plural subject.
e: la cabeza de todo poder y autoridad
cabeza is used figuratively as ‘head’; de introduces the domain over which it is head.

g: fueron circuncidados
fueron + participle is a preterite passive; the readers receive the action.
e: no por mano humana
por names agency; no por mano humana denies human agency.

g: al ser sepultados
al + infinitive expresses time: ‘when being buried’; ser sepultados is passive.
e: de entre los muertos
de entre means ‘from among’ and identifies the source group in resurrection language.

g: Dios nos dio vida
nos is the indirect object before dio; dar vida means ‘give life’.
e: en unión con Cristo
en unión con means ‘in union with’ and describes the relationship of new life.

g: que teníamos pendiente
que refers to deuda; teníamos is imperfect for an ongoing outstanding obligation.
e: clavándola en la cruz
The gerund clavándola has attached feminine la for deuda: ‘nailing it to the cross’.

g: los humilló en público
los is the direct object before the preterite humilló; en público states the setting.
e: su desfile triunfal
A victory-procession image; triunfal describes the desfile as celebrating triumph.

g: nadie los juzgue
A negative third-person subjunctive command: ‘let no one judge you’; los is the object.
e: con respecto a
A fixed prepositional phrase meaning ‘with respect to’ or ‘regarding’.

g: las cosas que están por venir
estar por + infinitive means ‘be yet to come’; están agrees with plural cosas.
e: la realidad se halla en Cristo
hallarse means ‘be found’; the phrase contrasts reality with the earlier shadow.

g: No dejen que les prive
No dejen que + subjunctive prive means ‘do not let ... deprive you’; les is indirect object.
e: hacen alarde de
hacer alarde de is an idiom meaning ‘make a show of’ or ‘boast about’.

g: va creciendo como Dios quiere
ir + gerund shows ongoing growth; como Dios quiere means ‘as God wills’.
e: firmemente unidos a la Cabeza
unidos a means ‘joined to’; Cabeza is capitalized as the image’s referent.

g: Si con Cristo ... han muerto
si + present perfect presents the stated premise; han muerto is plural for ustedes.
e: como si todavía pertenecieran
como si takes imperfect subjunctive pertenecieran for an unreal comparison.

g: No tomes ... no pruebes ... no toques
Three negative tú commands use present subjunctives, giving quoted rule-like prohibitions.
e: No tomes en tus manos
The literal phrase ‘do not take in your hands’ makes the prohibition more concrete.

g: cosas que van a desaparecer
ir a + infinitive gives near future; que refers to plural cosas.
e: con el uso
con el uso means ‘with use’ or ‘through being used’, explaining their disappearance.

g: pero de nada sirven
de nada means ‘of no use’; sirven is plural for the stated practices.
e: frente a los apetitos
frente a means ‘in the face of’ or ‘against’ in this contrast.
